Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human histone deacetylase 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter by target name 'histone deacetylase 1' and target organism 'Homo sapiens'. Require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier ascending.
